integrity: The proof is analytic; the accompanying finite checker is reproducibility evidence, not an independent infinite certificate. No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact result covers only the unweighted three-vertex path and centered fractional graph-ball averages for 0<alpha<1; no claims for longer paths, weighted graphs, or all equality pairs. Priority assessment is relative to inspected literature and may miss unindexed equivalent results.
title: A discontinuous sharp perturbation modulus for fractional maximal averaging on the three-vertex path
